thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for synthetic check 'canary-usw-01/synth-latency' — 5xx rate 22% (5m) · Pager: pagerduty-bot

pagerduty-bot: Incident P1 created and paging rotation started. Acknowledge required.

sre-joe: acked on PD. I'm on it, looking at the synth runner results and prober logs.

maria-g: seeing spike in 5xx from prober runner 3 in us-west-1. Quick snapshot from prober logs:```
[2026-03-15T10:15:02Z] probe=canary-usw-01 url=/v1/health status=500 body=\"internal error\"
[2026-03-15T10:15:07Z] probe=canary-usw-01 url=/v1/health status=502 body=\"upstream timeout\"
[2026-03-15T10:16:10Z] probe=canary-usw-01 url=/v1/health status=200 latency=120ms
```

kai: tagging in. Any recent deploys to inference edge in us-west? checking deploy bot...

oncall-sre: no infra deploys in last 30m from deploy-bot. Routing config changed ~2h ago per git history but not in last 30m.

anna: Confirming customer telemetry: a small percentage of production traffic to hosted-api-usw saw 5xx spikes concurrently, but lower volume than synth. Looks correlated to long-running KV cache misses.

maria-g: prober logs show repeated upstream timeouts to model-backend-2 (10.28.5.12). Trying a direct curl from prober runner:```
curl -svS http://10.28.5.12:8080/v1/health --max-time 5
# -> Connection timed out / 504 from proxy
```

sre-joe: running a quick tcpdump on the node and checking iptables: nothing obvious. Can we failover synth to another backend pool and see if errors persist?

kai: doing a canary switch: updating probers to route to model-backend-1 (10.28.4.11) only for a minute. Command:```
kubectl patch configmap synth-routing -n infra --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/backends/us-west","value":["10.28.4.11"]}]'
```

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: on-call SE rotation notified due to P1 condition (>20% 5xx for 5m).

oncall-sre: @kai +1, also throttling synthetic runner to reduce potential overload: set concurrency to 10 (was 50).

devx-luis: FYI some customers use hosted-api-usw pinned endpoints — should we notify support/CS if this will affect customers?

maria-g: after routing change and throttling, observed errors drop to 0-1% over next 60s. Looks like backend-2 is the cause. Still investigating why backend-2 is failing.

sre-joe: pulled system metrics from backend-2: memory stable, but kernel OOM kill events for sidecar process handling TLS were present around 10:12-10:14. Logs:```
Mar 15 10:12:57 backend-2 sidecar[1234]: OOM killer invoked, killing process tls-proxy (pid 2345)
Mar 15 10:13:01 backend-2 systemd[1]: tls-proxy.service: main process exited, code=killed status=9
```

kai: that matches the timing. Looks like TLS sidecar crash caused upstream to return 5xx from proxy. Could be recent change in sidecar image or config. Any recent image rollouts?

oncall-sre: I see a sidecar image rebuild pushed 2h ago to canary channel but shouldn't have rolled to backend-2. However auto-rollout policy triggered for hardware class mismatch. Opening quick rollback for sidecar on backend-2.

maria-g: rolling back sidecar image tag to v2.3.1 on backend-2 now. Command:```
kubectl set image deploy/model-backend-2 sidecar=registry.redwood/sidecar:v2.3.1 -n inference && kubectl rollout status deploy/model-backend-2 -n inference --watch
```

anna: Customer impact: approx 0.5% of total production requests experienced 5xx during the 10:12-10:16 window; a handful (<10) of long-polling sessions got aborted. No broad data loss. We should prepare a brief blurb for support: "Intermittent 5xx for hosted-api-usw between 10:12-10:18 UTC due to sidecar crash; mitigation applied; rolling recovery in progress."

pagerduty-bot: page acknowledged by kai and sre-joe. PD incident status: acknowledged -> investigating.

kai: rollback complete, sidecar restarted, health checks passing on backend-2. Observed full recovery at 10:22. Re-enabled synth concurrency to normal levels.

sre-joe: re-running prober curl: 200 OK, latency stable. Patch will be applied to remaining hosts after postmortem.

maria-g: marking the incident as mitigated in the thread. Please add any follow-up tasks.

oncall-sre: handing off to kai for post-incident doc and runbook update. @kai please add a follow-up: pin sidecar auto-rollout, add memory headroom alert for sidecar OOM, and add synth-detection automated failover to avoid customer-visible spikes.

kai: will do. Proposed follow-ups: [1] Pin v2.3.1 for sidecar auto-rollout until further testing. [2] Add OOM alerts for sidecar with 1m window. [3] Small synthetic-runner gradual backoff change to avoid thundering probes.

anna: closing customer communication: drafting message for support and for status.redwood with impact summary.

incident-bot: Incident marked MITIGATED (P1 -> resolved) at 4690012765. Please file postmortem in postmortems/ and link to this thread.

sre-joe: thanks all. :thumbsup:

kai: assigning postmortem to myself, will share draft by EOD.

anna: good job team — clean handoff.
